author: Arnav
problem: jobs lists the (start, end) minute of each print job a printer handled today; jobs never overlap. Return the longest time the printer sat idle between two jobs, or 0 if there was no gap.
bug_description: The jobs are never sorted by start time, so when they're listed out of order the neighbouring pairs aren't neighbours in time.

comments.accurate: Longest idle stretch between one print job ending and the next one starting
comments.wrong_behavior: Longest idle stretch between consecutive jobs, in the order the printer logged them
comments.wrong_location: Gap between neighbouring jobs verified; check whether idle time should be end - start
